blocks.body:
name = "acme/clock-bad-0"
version = "1.0.0"
[agent]
timeout = "30m"
network = "none"

[sandbox]
timezone = "America/New_York"
clock = { start = "2026-03-14T09:00:00", enforce = "vm" }

diagnostics.message: [sandbox] clock start 2026-03-14T09:00:00 has no offset: write it in RFC 3339 with the zone's offset, such as 2026-03-14T09:00:00-04:00, so the instant is not left to the machine that runs it
